title: HB0037 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 4, Chapter 54 and Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13, relative to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2023-01-26; official copy via LegiScan getBillText doc 2667001)
provenance.note: Draft as filed (2023-01-26), read from the House bill document that also names SB 659. Repealed 4-54-105 (the exclusions) is not shown; the state summary says it covers non-single-person firearms, multi-projectile firearms, large-bore firearms and exploding ammunition.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 4-54-105): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 4-54-105, is amended by deleting the section in its entirety.
SECTION 2 (new section, TCA Title 4, Ch. 54): An employee or elected or appointed official of a state or local government entity shall not enforce, or assist in the enforcement, of a federal law in violation of this chapter.
SECTION 3 (new section, TCA Title 39, Ch. 17, Pt. 13(a)): (a) It is an offense for a person to disenfranchise another of the person's constitutional rights in violation of Title 4, Chapter 54.
SECTION 3 (new section, TCA Title 39, Ch. 17, Pt. 13(d)): (1) A violation of subsection (a) is a Class A misdemeanor.
